title: StegVerse signed NODE_LEDGER_OPENED envelope v1 (LC-KV-16)
description: The InTr anchor body for an EPHEMERAL node ledger: StegOS's generation-time record (node-ledger-opened-generation.v1.json) plus a detached Ed25519 signature over common.signed_message('stegverse.node-ledger-opened-signature/v1', record) by a signer published in .stegverse/node-ledger/node-ledger-opened-signers.v1.json (TV/TVC custody; bots never hold keys). An unsigned record is FAIL_CLOSED NODE_LEDGER_OPENED_UNSIGNED, an unpublished key_id NODE_LEDGER_OPENED_SIGNER_NOT_PUBLISHED, a non-verifying signature NODE_LEDGER_OPENED_SIGNATURE_INVALID. Producer: llm_adapter.endpoint_ledger_anchor.signed_opened; verifier: opened_signature_failure (stdlib llm_adapter.ed25519_verify).
